purpose: Tracked audit gaps whose original implementation evidence has been superseded by the current architecture. Capabilities remain unverified until fresh integration evidence closes each item.

evidence: crates/application/execution/src/lib.rs: BasicAgentEngine::start_run persists the objective into runtime state/context
crates/application/execution/src/lib.rs: resume_run invokes ModelProvider and transitions durable run state
gaps.required_behavior: A Run must deterministically cross the AgentEngine -> ModelProvider boundary and preserve request/response identity.

evidence: crates/infrastructure/providers/src/platform.rs: ProviderPlatform execute_routed dispatches through execute_protocol over real HTTP transports
crates/infrastructure/providers/tests/provider_plane_integration.rs: deterministic local HTTP servers verify successful transport and non-success responses
gaps.required_behavior: Provider transport must make a real bounded request through the adapter, normalize failures and remain testable with deterministic integration fixtures.

evidence: crates/infrastructure/tools/src/lib.rs: BasicPolicyEngine delegates protected-tool authorization to CapabilityManager
crates/infrastructure/security/src/lib.rs: CapabilityManager.authorize validates grant existence, expiry, capability type, resource scope and permission
gaps.required_behavior: Authorization must validate an issued capability grant, its principal/scope, requested capability and expiry.

evidence: crates/infrastructure/memory/src/lib.rs: PersistentMemoryStore provides SQLite-backed durable memory/retrieval
crates/infrastructure/kernel/src/lib.rs: SqliteMemory persists session history and context state
gaps.required_behavior: Context and memory must have a persistence adapter and restart/recovery tests behind the existing storage contract.

evidence: crates/infrastructure/kernel/src/lib.rs: KernelRuntime reconstructs durable runs from persistent event/snapshot state
gaps.required_behavior: Run ownership/recovery must derive from durable kernel state rather than a process-local registry.

verification_policy.close_only_after: Fresh CI and capability-specific integration evidence confirm the affected contract, integration, persistence/security requirements and recovery semantics.
verification_policy.production_complete_definition: Feature completion requires user reachability, contract connection, persistence where appropriate, security, observability, failure tolerance, tests and documentation.
